svg.desc: AI Smart Interview Guide — AI-powered interview simulation platform. Features: Resume-based questions; Adaptive follow-up questions; Voice AI interviewer; Speech-to-text answers; Gemini feedback on answers; Dashboard & PDF report. Tech: Python, Streamlit, Gemini API, edge-tts, Plotly, ReportLab. Repository: github.com/thedenilsonpinto/AI-Smart-Interview-Guide.
